Section 6N.09 identifies both as applications for detouring or diverting road users on two-lane highways. The scene confirms the opposing-direction lane is fully closed, but it does not confirm whether opposing traffic is routed through an on-site temporary diversion, an off-site detour, or another arrangement. Because that unresolved routing condition determines the primary Typical Application, no primary TA can be selected without guessing. The apparent roadway form and short duration do not resolve this mutually exclusive choice."}
